tools.name: local_llm_overview
tools.title: Local LLM overview
tools.description: Hardware (GPU, VRAM, other GPU users, RAM, disk), runners with status, the model catalog with per-runner sizes, download state and admission, and the active deployment.

preview.description: Admission for a Run form's values, without saving or downloading.

tools.name: local_llm_status
tools.title: Local LLM status
tools.description: Phase, download progress, runner log lines after a sequence number, GPU memory, the runner-reported GPU buffers and the admission estimate.

tools.name: local_llm_run
tools.title: Run a local model
tools.description: Validate and admit the parameters, then download (only if needed) and start the model on the chosen runner. Returns at once; poll local_llm_status. Idempotent per requestId.

tools.name: local_llm_stop
tools.title: Stop the local model
tools.description: Stop the running model (or an in-progress download) and free the GPU.

tools.name: local_llm_download_cancel
tools.title: Cancel the download
tools.description: Cancel the download in progress, keeping the partial file so the next Run resumes it.

tools.name: local_llm_weights_delete
tools.title: Delete downloaded weights
tools.description: Free the disk used by one model's weights of one format (gguf or ollama), or of the format a runner reads; every runner of that format loses them. Refused while the weights are in use.

format.description: The weight format to delete; give this or runnerId.

tools.name: local_llm_model_add
tools.title: Add a model
tools.description: Add a user model. Its sources are keyed by weight format: gguf, a single-file GGUF on Hugging Face (read by llama.cpp); ollama, an Ollama library tag. Pins the Hugging Face revision; downloads nothing.

tools.name: local_llm_model_update
tools.title: Update a model
tools.description: Replace a user model entry. Seed entries are read-only; a model in use cannot be changed.

tools.name: local_llm_model_remove
tools.title: Remove a model
tools.description: Remove a user model entry after its weights are deleted. Seed entries are read-only.

tools.name: local_llm_test_prompt
tools.title: Test prompt
tools.description: Admin-only smoke test: send one prompt to the active local runner on loopback inside this agent (the bounded exception in DS001 Question #3) and return the text with the runner's tokens per second.

observationId.description: Optional transient observation ID for a bounded streamed admin prompt.

tools.name: local_llm_runner_install
tools.title: Install a runner
tools.description: Install an on-demand runner from the image's runner lock: download its pinned files into /data/runners, verify every sha256, and build the runnable copy offline. Returns at once; local_llm_overview shows progress. A runner whose licence needs acceptance (for example AGPL-3.0) requires acceptLicence; the acceptance is recorded with the caller and the time.

runnerId.description: A runner listed in this image's runner lock or in the agent's own lock (local_llm_overview shows which runners can be installed here).

acceptLicence.description: Accept the runner's licence terms, shown in the Runners tab, on this workspace's behalf.

tools.name: local_llm_runner_uninstall
tools.title: Uninstall a runner
tools.description: Delete an on-demand runner's downloaded files and runnable copy. Refused while the runner runs a model.

runnerId.description: A runner listed in this image's runner lock or in the agent's own lock (local_llm_overview shows which runners can be installed here).

tools.name: local_llm_model_lookup
tools.title: Look up a model
tools.description: Look a model up before adding it, on huggingface.co (when registry is left out) or in a Hugging Face-compatible, ModelScope or OCI registry (dockerhub, ghcr, or one an administrator added) enabled under Registries: the commit the revision resolves to (for an OCI registry, the manifest digest the tag names, its layout and licence), whether the repository is gated, its licence, and the files of the format with their sizes and sha256 (GGUF files with their quantization, a split GGUF grouped under its first shard). The answer names the registry. For one GGUF file it also reads the start of that file (at most 32 MiB) for its layer count, training context and KV cache size; for a safetensors or EXL3 snapshot the sizing comes from its config.json, checked against the digest in the repository listing. Downloads no weights and writes nothing; add the model with local_llm_model_add, then Run it. Registries are reached only at globally routable addresses.

registry.description: The id of a registry from local_llm_registry_list; huggingface when left out.

provider.description: huggingface only, and only with no registry or the huggingface registry.

repo.description: A repository id: owner/name for Hugging Face-compatible and ModelScope registries, 2-4 lowercase segments (such as ai/smollm2) for an OCI registry.

revision.description: A branch, tag or commit; main when left out (master for a ModelScope registry). For an OCI registry, a tag; latest when left out.

format.description: gguf (when left out) lists GGUF files; hf and exl3 list a snapshot's files. An OCI registry offers gguf and hf (CNCF per-file safetensors).

file.description: One GGUF file (the first shard of a split GGUF) whose header is read for its sizing. format gguf only.

tools.name: local_llm_registry_list
tools.title: List model registries
tools.description: List the registries models can come from: the built-in huggingface, dockerhub, ghcr and modelscope, and those an administrator added. Each shows its kind, URL, weight formats, whether it is enabled, its auth origins, whether a credential is set (set, none, or unreadable when this agent's key cannot read it), and the models that use it. credentialStorage says whether credentials can be stored. Never returns a credential.

tools.name: local_llm_registry_save
tools.title: Add or change a model registry
tools.description: Add a registry (id, kind huggingface, oci or modelscope, an https url naming a DNS host, optional label, enabled and, for oci, up to 4 authOrigins), or change one. The kind never changes, and the URL cannot change while a model uses the registry. A new URL or new auth origins delete the stored credential. Built-in registries can only be enabled or disabled; huggingface cannot be changed. Registries are reached only at globally routable addresses.

url.description: https://host[:port], plus a path prefix for the huggingface kind.

authOrigins.description: oci only: the https origins whose token realm may receive the credential.

tools.name: local_llm_registry_remove
tools.title: Remove a model registry
tools.description: Remove a registry an administrator added, and its credential. Refused while a model uses it. Built-in registries cannot be removed.

tools.name: local_llm_registry_credential_set
tools.title: Set a registry credential
tools.description: Store a registry's credential, encrypted, replacing any earlier one: a bearer token for the huggingface and modelscope kinds, or tokenUsername and token for an oci token realm. Write-only: no tool returns it. Refused with credentials_unavailable when the agent did not receive its credentials key, and for huggingface, which uses the operator's HF_TOKEN.

tokenUsername.description: oci only: the user name sent with the token to the token realm.

tools.name: local_llm_registry_credential_clear
tools.title: Clear a registry credential
tools.description: Delete a registry's stored credential; requests to it are then anonymous.
